task_name: C4-H3: Employment intake in Washington with packet and note
intent: Open with exactly: "I was fired after I reported safety violations." When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Harborline Industries." Washington. April fifth, twenty twenty six. Give a short account when asked. If they record intake, say exactly: "Please add an intake note that I still have the email I sent to HR about the safety violations." If offered the packet, say exactly: "Email is fine." Decline booking. Stay until they confirm the intake, the note, and the email packet are on the file. A spoken promise that they will take care of it, without those writes, is not enough. Once they confirm the intake, the note, and the email packet are on the file, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." Do not book an evaluation. End the call.

parameters.note: Caller still has the HR email about the safety violations.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.
The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.
The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, or who this would be against. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.
The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the accident, injury or event. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was April fifth, twenty twenty six.
